summary: Adds a `significantDigits` option to prettyBytes so callers can change the default 3-digit rounding. Implemented with readme, types and tests; the suite passes, but the change is not yet committed.
narrative: The owner asked for a `significantDigits` option that changes the default rounding and applies only when the fraction-digit options aren't set. The agent found the default rounding in the no-locale-options branch of prettyBytes and added a `significantDigitsOf` helper. Invalid values fall back to 3. It then documented the option in the readme and types and added three test blocks. It adjusted one locale expectation and added a type-level test, and npm test passed at 53 tests. Five modified files were still uncommitted at the last activity, and memory shows no commit, PR or release.
